description: Current conditions and a one- to seven-day weather forecast for an island, read at sea level where most visitors stay: Waikīkī on Oʻahu, Kāʻanapali on Maui, Līhuʻe on Kauaʻi and Kailua-Kona on Hawaiʻi Island. The reply names the place. Returns temperature, precipitation, wind and UV index.
name: get_hawaii_weather
title: Hawaii Weather Forecast
